note: Adapters are contracts, not integrations. None is assumed connected. Detection can only prove local binaries and env-var NAMES; MCP/connector tools must be inspected by the agent in the live session. Never store credential values here.

image-generation.purpose: Create images (character/environment references, keyframes) from prompt files.
image-generation.input: prompts/images/<id>.md (prompt, negative, refs, aspect, seed policy)

detect.mcp_hint: image generation tools exposed in the session

video-generation.input: prompts/video/<shot_id>.md (motion prompt, start frame, duration, aspect, fps)
video-generation.output: media/video/<shot_id>/vNN.mp4 + log row; probed with media-inspection

detect.mcp_hint: video generation tools exposed in the session
text-to-speech tools exposed in the session

speech-generation.fallback: Produce dialogue sheet and recording script; stage -> BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_TOOL

video-editing.purpose: Assemble cuts beyond what FFmpeg scripting offers (NLE project export).

detect.mcp_hint: any NLE/video-render tool in the session

video-editing.fallback: FFmpeg concat recipe or written EDL

ffmpeg.purpose: Transcode, concat, mux, scale, extract frames.
ffmpeg.fallback: Provide commands for the human to run

media-inspection.purpose: Report real duration, resolution, fps, codecs, audio of a media file.
